title: Connect Claude
description: Let Claude Code run your test cases with a personal token.

steps.label: How to connect
steps.create: Create a token for one project.
steps.install: Run the command it shows in your terminal.

create.viewerApiHint: You are a Viewer in this project, so this token can read runs, failures and test cases but not import results.

created.title: Token for {{projectKey}}
created.shownOnce: Copy it now. You will not see this token again.
created.httpsOnly: Claude Code installs the plugin only from an HTTPS address. On a local copy of Tessio, start Claude Code with claude --plugin-dir claude from the repository instead.
created.apiCommandLabel: Import JUnit results from CI with this call:
created.apiHint: Store the token as a CI secret. It works only for the JUnit import and for reading runs, failures and test cases over the REST API, not for Claude Code.

revoke.description: Claude stops working with "{{name}}" in {{projectKey}} at once.
